android.desc:
Take control of your viewing and listening experience.

FilterTube brings Main and Kids viewing, API Music, podcasts, offline media and powerful filtering to Android phones and tablets. Choose what appears in your viewing space, reduce distractions and keep separate rules for every profile and cross device p2p sync.

Every feature remains free. No FilterTube account is required.

MAIN AND KIDS VIEWING

• Browse personalised feeds, subscriptions, channels, playlists and history with an optionally linked API account.
• Continue watching from your recent activity.
• Create playlists, save videos and manage playback queues.
• Keep video notes and reopen saved moments.
• Use parent-managed Kids viewing with independent filtering rules.

FILTERING THAT YOU CONTROL

• Block videos using keywords, topics and dates.
• Block or allow channels by handle or channel ID.
• Keep separate Blocked and Allowed collections.
• Build approved-only viewing spaces with Whitelist Mode.
• Hide Shorts, comments, live chat and supported advertising or promotional placements.
• Filter comments using keywords.
• Apply rules across supported feeds and recommendations.

Filtering coverage can vary as API responses and playback systems change.

API MUSIC AND PODCASTS

• Discover music through Home and Explore.
• Browse new releases, charts, moods and genres.
• Explore artists, songs, albums and playlists.
• Browse podcasts, shows and episodes.
• Access account-linked library collections where available.
• Switch between audio and video for supported content.
• View available lyrics and manage your listening queue.
• Continue listening in the background with notification controls.

OFFLINE MEDIA

Save supported videos, audio, albums and finite playlists for later listening or viewing.

• Choose from available video qualities or audio-only formats.
• Monitor downloads and pause, retry or cancel them.
• Find saved items and grouped collections in Offline media.
• Play downloaded content through FilterTube’s local audio and video players.
• Browse device files, folders, albums and artists.
• View available artwork and metadata, maintain favourites and create playback queues.
• Share or save a public copy of supported completed downloads.

quotes.text:
It all started with this thread blocked by Google Mods where parents were simply asking for a tool to block videos/content based on words and so on. Instead of providing this utility Google Mods deleted mine and other parents comments and locked the thread- https://support.google.com/youtubekids/thread/54509605/how-to-block-videos-by-keyword-or-tag?hl=en

One parent asked me if I can do something as a programmer as his kid is kept crying and he said he is helpless and hence here it is.
Here is the video(old) of FilterTube working https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dmLUu3lm7dE
and yes it is also restoring well the content in UI, which I forget to show :)

FilterTube is also available currently for Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.filtertube.app

iOS app is Work in Progress.

Free Opens Source - 
https://github.com/varshneydevansh/FilterTube
